sections.title: Hotfix Bug Fix Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix for bugs recently discovered. Replay codes from the August 26, 2025 patch are still available.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Resolved an issue where real-time text moderation was not working correctly. Resolved an issue where Universal Emotes could not be equipped.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Doomfist Resolved an issue where Doomfist Aftershock Perk not correctly applying slow if you land directly on top of enemies. Echo Resolved an issue where Echo equipped with the Partial Scan perk was not gaining Ultimate Charge when duplicating D.Va. Hazard Resolved an issue with Hazard’s infinite block when the Reconstitution Perk was equipped. Sombra Resolved an issue where Sombra was able to gain overhealth from unhacked health packs. Symmetra Resolved an issue where Symmetra’s teleporter was able to recover shield HP while being hacked. Venture Resolved an issue where using SMART extender during Drill Dash would break the animation. Wrecking Ball Resolved an issue with Wrecking Ball’s launch momentum. Zarya Resolved an issue with Zarya’s Energy Converter Perk not granting charge for each enemy hit.
